args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS net_cents
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'East'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'

args.content: Computed: total net revenue (amount - discount, completed orders only) for the 'focus region' (East, per insight correction superseding prior West definition — memory.bench.customers.region joined to memory.bench.orders) in calendar year 2025 = $257,733.53 (25,773,353 cents over 163 completed orders). Used memory.bench.orders directly (not daily_region_revenue, which is gross-only and stale after 2025-11-30) per the Revenue Reporting Policy (kp-bench-1).
